files.src/command-palette.css:
.command-palette { display: grid; gap: var(--kui-space-3); inline-size: min(40rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); }
#command-results { display: grid; gap: var(--kui-space-1); max-block-size: min(50vh, 24rem); overflow: auto; }

followUp.concept: Propose a reusable CommandPalette primitive or recipe upstream, with grouped results, managed active-descendant keyboard navigation, empty-state semantics, and a history slot; keep command data, parsing, and execution in each application.
